summary: Situated within a popular and well-established residential area of Hartlepool, this three bedroom family home enjoys a convenient location ideally suited to families, first-time buyers and investors alike.
description:
The property is positioned close to a wide range of local amenities including supermarkets, schools, leisure facilities and everyday shopping, ensuring all essential services are within easy reach. Hartlepool town centre and Marina are both easily accessible, offering an excellent selection of restaurants, cafés, bars and retail outlets, together with scenic coastal walks and recreational attractions. The area also benefits from good transport connections, including road links and public transport routes providing straightforward access to surrounding towns and cities across the North East. Combining convenience with a welcoming residential setting, this location offers the perfect balance of everyday practicality and community living. The property itself briefly comprises an entrance porch, dining room, kitchen, lounge and ground floor WC, whilst to the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom. Externally, there is a garden forecourt to the front and a good sized enclosed rear courtyard benefitting from brick built storage. The property offers excellent potential throughout and would benefit from some cosmetic upgrading, making it an ideal opportunity for buyers looking to personalise a home to their own taste and specification.

ENTRANCE PORCH Accessed via a UPVC framed double glazed entrance door, the entrance porch provides a practical and welcoming entry to the home, with a further internal door leading through into the dining room.

DINING ROOM A well-proportioned dining room benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, creating a bright and welcoming space ideal for family dining and entertaining. The room also features a radiator and provides access through to the kitchen, offering a practical flow throughout the ground floor accommodation.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of base units complemented by laminate work surfaces, providing a practical space with excellent potential for modernisation and personalisation. Features include an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, plumbing for an automatic washing machine, and space for a cooker. A UPVC framed double glazed window allows for natural light, while a door provides access through to the hallway.

HALLWAY The hallway provides stairs access to the first floor accommodation and benefits from a useful built-in understairs storage cupboard, offering practical household storage. A UPVC framed double glazed door provides access out to the rear courtyard, while natural light helps create a bright and functional connecting space within the home.

LOUNGE A comfortable sized lounge benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The room is further enhanced by a radiator, providing warmth and comfort throughout the year.

GROUND FLOOR WC Fitted with a wash hand basin and WC, the ground floor cloakroom provides useful additional convenience for everyday family living. The room also benefits from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light and ventilation.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing provides access to all bedrooms and the family bathroom and benefits from a useful built-in storage cupboard together with loft access, offering additional practicality and storage options.

BEDROOM ONE A well-proportioned bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light. The room is further enhanced by a radiator providing warmth throughout the year.

BEDROOM TWO A further well-proportioned bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, together with a radiator creating a warm and comfortable living space.

BEDROOM THREE A versatile third bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort. The room would lend itself perfectly as a child's bedroom, guest room or home office.

FAMILY BATHROOM Fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset mains-fed shower over, wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from tiled walls providing a clean finish, along with a radiator for comfort. A UPVC framed double glazed window allows for natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property is a wall-enclosed forecourt garden with gated access, providing an attractive and neatly defined frontage. To the rear is a generously sized enclosed courtyard, offering a private outdoor space ideal for seating and low-maintenance enjoyment. The courtyard also benefits from gated access and a brick-built storage unit, providing useful external storage.
